title: Industrial Cybersecurity Expert (m/f/d)
description: Job Title Industrial Cybersecurity Lab Administrator and Developer (m/f/d) A Snapshot of Your Day You work in the area of Security, Network & IT (SNI), taking on a role that combines lab administration with hands-on cybersecurity development. At the center of your day is our lab – the shared environment that developers and testers across our organization rely on to build, test, and validate secure industrial systems. You keep this lab running: administering tools and access, maintaining the infrastructure, and making sure every user gets a reliable environment to work in. Alongside this, you contribute to cybersecurity development wherever your skills are needed. Your work sits at the intersection of lab operations and cybersecurity development, and you enjoy switching between both. How You’ll Make an Impact Administering the lab: Operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting the lab environment that development and test teams across the organization depend on. Enabling remote access: Setting up and supporting secure remote access to the lab for distributed teams. Supporting patch and firmware rollout: Helping pre-test and roll out patches and firmware releases on schedule. Maintaining testing infrastructure: Keeping test environments in the lab reliable and available. Contributing to cybersecurity development: Supporting the development and improvement of security features as part of the team. Collaborating across teams: Working closely with developers and security teams worldwide to keep the lab and its services running smoothly. What You Bring Completed studies or equivalent experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT/OT Security, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable qualification – relevant practical experience is equally valued. Lab and IT infrastructure experience: Hands-on experience administering lab/test environments, virtualization platforms, networks, or remote access solutions. OT/IT security awareness: Basic understanding of industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) is a plus. Service-minded and reliable: A structured, detail-oriented way of working – other teams depend on the lab you keep running. Communication skills: Proficient in English, comfortable collaborating with international, distributed teams. Motivation and enthusiasm: Genuine interest in a role that spans hands-on development and lab operations. Personal Development and Career Growth At Siemens Energy, we believe in the importance of personal development and continuous learning. In this role, you build a broad skill set spanning both cybersecurity development and lab/infrastructure operations – a valuable and versatile combination. Over time, this can open paths toward roles such as Framework Developer, Lab or Infrastructure Owner, or Tool Owner, and further into cybersecurity engineering or infrastructure leadership within Siemens Energy's Security, Network & IT (SNI) organization. About the Team [will be filled in by Talent Acquisition] Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 94,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. title: Lead Analyst, Design Assurance & Product Management - Network & Zero Trust
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Domain focus: Design Assurance for Network & Zero Trust, Platform Security and MDR & Detection Engineering.**

**Job Purpose:**

Domain analyst covering three interconnected domains: Network and Zero Trust, Platform Security, and MDR and Detection Engineering. You perform pre-production and BAU reviews for tooling in these domains, validating configurations against the applicable architecture standards.

About the team. Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different.** A domain review role covering three technical areas that connect but are not the same, so you need breadth and the appetite to build more. You verify against standards set by the architecture domains; you do not write them, and you will sometimes be reviewing designs produced by architects more senior than you. Accuracy matters more than speed because assurance records serve as audit evidence.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Perform pre-production reviews for network security and Zero Trust tooling, validating against ZT enforcement point, segmentation, SD-WAN, SASE and secure remote access standards.
* Review SIEM, SOAR and EDR/XDR platform configurations against platform security architecture standards.
* Review detection engineering outputs against the MDR architecture standards, including rule frameworks and coverage mapping.
* Run pre-production and business-as-usual reviews across Network and Zero Trust, Platform Security, and MDR and Detection Engineering, escalating cross-domain and precedent-setting designs to senior review.
* Record each finding against the specific clause of the standard it breaches, so the submitting team can remediate without a follow-up conversation, and track it to evidenced closure.
* Validate that the MDR provider's delivered detection content matches the agreed MITRE ATT&CK coverage commitment, and that the SIEM data sources those detections depend on are actually ingesting.
* Validate Zero Trust enforcement points, segmentation policy and SASE and SD-WAN configurations against the Network and Zero Trust architecture standards.
* Flag recurring findings as candidate standards gaps for escalation to the owning architecture domain — you identify the pattern, you do not draft the standard.
* Apply the published methodology and scoring criteria consistently, and raise ambiguity in them through the practice rather than interpreting privately.
* Build working depth in the domains you did not arrive with — most candidates come from either network and Zero Trust or from detection engineering, rarely both.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 10+ years in cyber security — domain focus: Design Assurance for Network & Zero Trust, Platform Security and MDR & Detection Engineering
* Pre-production design assurance reviews of network security and Zero Trust tooling
* Reviewing SIEM, SOAR and EDR/XDR platform configurations, detection rule implementations and MDR vendor integration against platform standards
* Preparing review packs, documenting findings and tracking remediation with automated templates, working accurately to process and escalating Critical/High findings
* Reviewing AI-enabled detection and SOC tooling — ML detections, GenAI copilots and agentic SOAR playbooks — against platform and AI security standards

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Zero Trust enforcement points, segmentation, SD-WAN/SASE and secure remote access
* MITRE ATT&CK coverage and detection-as-code
* Platform hardening and SIEM data source ingestion — and scripting for review automation
* GxP-compliant documentation practice

* Security certification such as GIAC (GCIA, GCDA) or CompTIA Security+
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Configuration review of Zero Trust enforcement points, segmentation, SASE and SD-WAN tooling, SIEM, SOAR and EDR/XDR platform configuration review, detection content validation against MITRE ATT&CK, assurance register maintenance, ServiceNow.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Design Assurance, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, IT Networking, ML Security, Network Access Protection, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), Vulnerability Management, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

**Domain focus: Security products for Network & Zero Trust and MDR & Detection Engineering.**

**Job Purpose:**

Own security product management for Network, Zero Trust and MDR: the product lifecycle, roadmap, adoption and outcomes for the tooling in these domains. You define requirements with the architecture domains, manage vendor delivery, and own the investment case and total cost position.

**About the team**:

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. Zero Trust at GSK is being built from the ground up, so you are not optimising a mature product set — you are sequencing a migration off an estate people are comfortable with, against application owners who will tell you their system cannot tolerate segmentation. You own the product, the roadmap and the investment; Network and Zero Trust Architecture owns the design standards and you do not. You are measured on enforcement coverage and detection quality in production, not on whether tooling was delivered.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Own the product lifecycle and roadmap for Network, Zero Trust and MDR security tooling.
* Define product requirements with the architecture domains and track them through build to release.
* Own adoption as an enforcement figure — the share of application access brokered through Zscaler or Prisma Access rather than legacy VPN, and the share of the estate under Illumio microsegmentation policy — and act when migration stalls behind an application owner's objection.
* Manage Zscaler, Netskope, Illumio and the MDR provider against delivery and detection-quality commitments, including mean time to deploy new detection content and false-positive rates on tuned rules.
* Own the investment case and total cost of ownership position.
* Run the product governance forum and keep decisions traceable.
* Assess new network, ZT and detection tooling on commercial and lifecycle grounds — licence model, data egress cost, operability by the managed service — while Network and Zero Trust Architecture assesses technical fit.
* Land the consolidation of overlapping remote-access and proxy estates — legacy VPN concentrators, standalone secure web gateways and point CASB tools — into the SASE platform, on a dated retirement schedule.
* Act as the escalation point for the SOC and the network engineering teams when a detection gap or an enforcement-point outage is attributed to the product rather than the service.
* Drive the roadmap from identity-based intrusion and lateral movement: adversaries authenticating with valid credentials and moving east-west inside flat segments, which is why segmentation coverage and brokered-access share are the metrics this portfolio is judged on, not licences deployed.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Apply GxP, GDPR and data integrity requirements to the tooling in scope, so a routine product change cannot disturb a validated system or the records it holds.
* Coach domain analysts and peers in product management practice.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in cyber security in a regulated environment — domain focus: security products for Network & Zero Trust and MDR & Detection Engineering
* End-to-end product ownership of Network & Zero Trust and MDR & Detection Engineering tools — translating threat intelligence and CISO requirements into funded use cases, with 1-3 year roadmaps for investment, consolidation and retirement and published adoption metrics
* Vendor evaluation, selection and lifecycle management — value tracked against threat and risk coverage with automated performance reporting, driving decommission where value is not evidenced
* Working in parallel with the Security Solution Engineering squad for Network & Zero Trust and MDR & Detection Engineering — aligning use cases and roadmaps to build, test and vendor handover plans, and coordinating with architecture and Design Assurance without owning standards
* Evaluating AI-enabled network and detection products — AI-driven detection, GenAI SOC copilots and agentic SOAR — and their vendor AI claims

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Technical familiarity with Zero Trust enforcement points, segmentation, SASE and SD-WAN, secure remote access, SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR and MDR tooling
* Product management discipline — roadmaps, adoption and coverage metrics, and decommission business cases
* Vendor governance rhythm — QBRs, executive business reviews, SLA management and commercial negotiation input to Procurement
* Portfolio analytics, licence utilisation and renewal calendar management, with tracking and alerts automated through dashboards

* Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe POPM or equivalent) or CISSP
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Product roadmapping and adoption metrics, Network and Zero Trust tooling landscape including Zscaler, Netskope, Illumio and Prisma Access, MDR and detection tooling including Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike, vendor evaluation and proof-of-value, threat intelligence inputs to use-case definition, ServiceNow, Power BI.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Data Center Cybersecurity & Commissioning
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Technical Program Manager** to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of **data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management**.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the **construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated**. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management**

* Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
* Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
* Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
* Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.

* Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.

* Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
* Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
* Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.

**2. Construction & Commissioning Integration**

* Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
* Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
* Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
* Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
* Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.

**3. Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination**

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

* Building Management Systems (BMS)
* Power Management Systems (PMS)
* SCADA
* DCS and industrial control platforms
* PLCs and industrial controllers
* RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
* EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
* Environmental and mechanical controls
* Industrial networking infrastructure
* Engineering workstations and management platforms
* Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
* **Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.**

 **4. Data Center Operations Integration**

* Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
* Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
* Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
* Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
* Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.

**5. OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination**

* Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
* Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
* Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
* Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
* Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
* Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.

**6. Technical Logistics & Readiness**

Own the technical-readiness process covering:

* Site access
* Assessment workstations
* Network connectivity
* Engineering system access
* Required documentation
* Network and controls architecture
* Asset inventories
* Configuration documentation
* OEM technical resources
* System integrator resources
* Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
* Testing windows
* Evidence collection
* Technical repositories
* Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal **readiness gate** before site mobilization.

**7. Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination**

* Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
* Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
* Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
* Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
* Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
* Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
* Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.

**8. Program Governance & Reporting**

* Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
* Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers.
* Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings.
* Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders.
* Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions.
* Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities.

**Mandatory Experience**

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role.

**Data Center Experience**

* Significant experience delivering technical programs within **hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments**.
* Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.

**Construction Experience**

* Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls.

**Controls / OT Experience**

* Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems.
* Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.

**Networking Experience**

Working understanding of:

* TCP/IP
* VLANs
* Routing and switching
* Firewalls
* Network segmentation
* Industrial Ethernet
* Remote access
* IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements.

**Cybersecurity Experience**

* Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems.
* Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance.
* Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into activities that engineering and commissioning organizations can execute.

**Commissioning Experience**

* Direct experience working with commissioning organizations or commissioning programs.
* Understanding of FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning, acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate additional assurance requirements into an active commissioning environment.

**Program Management Experience**

* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-site technical programs.
* Experience managing multiple contractors, vendors, engineering organizations, and technical workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong dependency, escalation, risk, schedule, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

**Experience Level**

**12+ years of overall relevant industry experience**, including substantial experience across data center construction/commissioning and technical infrastructure programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechanical, Network, Computer, Systems, or related engineering degree.
* PMP or PgMP.
* Commissioning credentials such as CxA, CCP, CBCP, or equivalent experience.
* CISSP, GICSP, IEC 62443, or comparable cybersecurity certification.
* Experience with controls ecosystems from Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, ABB, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, or similar OEMs.
* Experience with mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
* Experience coordinating third-party testing, assurance, validation, inspection, or commissioning organizations.
* Experience supporting global programs spanning multiple regions and delivery organizations.

**Critical Competencies**

**Technical credibility**
  
Demonstrates sufficient technical depth to actively lead discussions with controls engineers, network engineers, commissioning teams, cybersecurity specialists, and data center operations personnel.

**Construction fluency**
  
Demonstrates strong understanding of construction execution, commissioning sequences, schedule pressures, project dependencies, and operational-readiness milestones.

**Systems and Safety thinking**
  
Identifies cross-functional dependencies affecting cybersecurity execution, including OEM contracts, construction schedules, controls integration, configurations, credentials, network readiness, technical ownership, and operational constraints.

**Execution discipline**
  
Turns program requirements into owners, dependencies, readiness gates, dates, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes.

**Vendor orchestration**
  
Can coordinate multiple Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents and technical vendors without allowing delivery methodology or quality to fragment between sites.

**Executive communication**
  
Can convert complex construction, OT, commissioning, cyber, and vendor issues into concise program-level decisions.

**Technical curiosity**
  
Demonstrates strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills to identify and resolve underlying readiness and execution constraints

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)** **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.

**Skills & Experience** **Exchange Online & Messaging**

* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.

**Email Security**

* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Experience administering secure email gateway
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.

**SMTP & Application Email**

* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.

**Identity, Automation & Operations**

* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.
* Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates.
* Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis.
* Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.

**Communication & Customer Support**

* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates.
* Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement.
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams.

**Personal Attributes**

* Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
* Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made.
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages.
* Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape.
* Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists.
* Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer.
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues.
* Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team.

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst.

They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed.

Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

**Desirable Qualifications & Vendor Experience**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate, or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Information Protection Administrator Associate (SC-400).
* Vendor training or certification from Proofpoint, Mimecast, Egress or a similar email security provider.
* Experience with DMARC reporting platforms.
* Experience in a large enterprise with many domains, business units or acquired companies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or divestments: domain migration, coexistence and mail routing during transition.
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge.

Company Overview

Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. About the Role

The SOC Analyst will work collaboratively on the Nuventure Connect 24x7 security operations team to monitor, investigate, analyse, and respond to threat activity in our client environments. The team’s purpose is to be an extension of our clients’ security operations team for continuous monitoring and response services in their environments. The SOC operates with core values of kindness, humility, and respect, and it is essential to be a team player with a selfless mentality as we aim to deliver success to our clients. As a contributor to the SOC team, the Junior SOC Analyst should aspire to perform all security operations tasks and obligations for our clients.

Working Conditions

* 24x7x365 environment, shift work
* Ability to deal with tough and demanding clients
* Productively work in a remote workspace and corporate office space, when necessary
* Business casual work environment

title: OT SECURITY ANALYST (EL)
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager

**Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)**

Supports ABB Electrification (EL) global OT security operations across worldwide factories and operational sites. Acts as coordinator and facilitator, bridging the gap between global OT security services, country-level Information Security (IS) teams, and factory operations to ensure cohesive and consistent OT security management. Responsible for OT device onboarding, vulnerability management, asset visibility, compliance support, and stakeholder reporting in alignment with ABB IS policies, standards, and global OT security frameworks.

The work model for the role is: **Onsite / Hybrid**

This role is contributing to the **Regional Security – AMEA / Head of Information Security & Compliance – EL**

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

**OT Device Onboarding & IDS Integration Facilitates and supports the onboarding of OT devices onto Intrusion Detection System (IDS) platforms, including Nozomi and Claroty, across global factory sites. Configures and maintains OT security modules within ServiceNow (SNOW) for asset and incident management. Coordinates with country IS teams and factory operations to ensure smooth integration and minimal operational disruption during onboarding activities.**

**Vulnerability Management**

Generates and analyzes vulnerability reports from IDS platforms and contextualizes findings within specific factory OT environments. Coordinates remediation efforts with factory and country IS teams, monitors progress, validates the effectiveness of fixes, and tracks remediation status to closure. Escalates critical vulnerabilities to the global OT security team with recommended risk-based actions.

**Asset Visibility & Inventory Management**

Maintains accurate and comprehensive OT asset inventories across IDS platforms and ServiceNow. Ensures full asset visibility for all onboarded factory sites. Validates asset data quality and consistency across platforms, identifying and resolving gaps or discrepancies in asset records.

**Assessment, Compliance & Audits**

Supports periodic OT security assessments, compliance checks, and audit activities to ensure adherence to ABB IS policies, OT security standards (ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF), and regulatory requirements. Assists in preparing factory IS teams for audits, participates in assessment activities, and documents findings with remediation recommendations.

**Reporting & Documentation**

Provides weekly status updates on onboarding progress, vulnerability management activities, and key risks to relevant stakeholders. Develops and maintains comprehensive monthly OT security dashboards for senior management visibility. Documents assessment findings, remediation plans, and progress against agreed milestones. Ensures all documentation meets ABB IS policy and audit readiness standards.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Coordination**

Acts as the primary liaison between global OT security services, country IS teams, and factory operations to ensure cohesive communication and execution of OT security activities. Creates effective partnerships with factory managers and country IS teams, promoting understanding of OT security risks, requirements, and remediation priorities. Coordinates meetings and workshops that bring teams into alignment, encourage engagement, and resolve issues across time zones and geographies.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

Sets up and improves local engagement processes to coordinate with global OT security services and meet compliance goals. Identifies process improvement opportunities across onboarding, vulnerability management, and reporting workflows. Contributes to the development of best-practice OT security procedures and playbooks for factory engagements.

**Internal Controls**

Ensures all activities comply with ABB Regulations, ABB Group IS Guidelines, and applicable security policies. Adheres to ABB data privacy and confidentiality requirements in all engagements. Ensures audit readiness at all times across assigned factory scopes.

**Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical/Control Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in OT/ICS security or industrial cybersecurity roles.
* At least 3 years of practical experience working with OT IDS platforms such as Nozomi Networks or Claroty.
* Demonstrated experience with IT Service Management tools, including ServiceNow.
* Experience in vulnerability management within OT/ICS environments.
* Experience overseeing OT security programs within manufacturing or other industrial settings.
* Experience working across multiple countries and cultures in a global organization.

**Technical Knowledge**

  

* Solid knowledge of OT security frameworks: ISA/IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-82.
* Deep familiarity with OT/ICS network architectures, the Purdue Model, and industrial protocols such as Modbus, PROFINET, DNP3, and OPC-UA.
* Knowledge of IT/OT convergence security challenges and best practices.
* Familiarity with ABB IS policies and security standards.

**Job Title:** SOC Threat Hunting Analyst
  
**Experience:** 4-8 Years (Senior Threat Hunter: 8-12 Years)
  
**Location:** Hybrid / Remote / Onsite
  
**Department:** Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC)

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Threat Hunting Analyst** to proactively identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats across enterprise environments. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in threat hunting, incident response, SIEM, EDR/XDR technologies, threat intelligence, and malware analysis. This role will work closely with SOC, Incident Response, Cloud Security, Infrastructure, and Security Engineering teams to strengthen organizational cyber resilience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoints, networks, cloud platforms, and identity systems.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and suspicious behaviors.
* Develop hunting hypotheses based on threat intelligence and emerging attack trends.
* Detect Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), ransomware, insider threats, and lateral movement activities.

* Support post-incident reviews and lessons learned activities.

* Active Directory

* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

* Defender for Cloud Apps

* Advanced Threat Hunting
* Incident Response

* Detection Engineering
* Log Analysis
* Malware Investigation
* Cyber Forensics
* Automation & SOAR
* Executive Reporting
* Problem Solving

* Lead enterprise-wide threat hunting programs.
* Build custom detection content and hunting playbooks.
* Develop SOC threat hunting strategy and roadmap.
* Lead purple-team and adversary simulation exercises.
* Mentor SOC L1/L2/L3 analysts.

A strong candidate should have hands-on experience with **Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, KQL, MITRE ATT&CK, Threat Intelligence, EDR/XDR platforms, ransomware investigations, cloud security, and advanced threat hunting across hybrid enterprise environments** . title: Cyber Security Senior Analyst/Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Network Security will lead the design, engineering, implementation, and continuous improvement of network security controls across a globally distributed industrial manufacturing environment. The role will secure enterprise networks, cloud connectivity, remote access, and IT/OT boundaries while ensuring resilient, scalable, and compliant security architecture across regions.

**Work this position does**

* Design, implement, and maintain global network security architecture, standards, and engineering baselines.
* Administer and optimize next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, secure remote access, VPN, SASE/SSE, IDS/IPS, and related security controls.
* Strengthen IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity to manufacturing sites, plants, data centers, and industrial systems in coordination with OT and plant engineering teams.
* Lead firewall rule reviews, access-control assessments, network security hardening, configuration reviews, and remediation of identified weaknesses.
* Support security incident response by investigating network-based threats, analyzing traffic and logs, implementing containment measures, and coordinating with the SOC and incident response teams.
* Manage network security changes, upgrades, lifecycle management, high availability, disaster recovery, and configuration backups.
* Establish global network security standards while accommodating regional regulatory requirements, data residency constraints, and operational needs.
* Evaluate new technologies, identify architectural gaps, and develop roadmaps for network security modernization.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, workplace technology, identity, vulnerability management, and third-party service providers.
* Maintain technical documentation, network security diagrams, operational procedures, audit evidence, and risk exceptions.
Provide technical inputs during complex implementations, outages, incidents, and security improvement initiatives.  

**Specific Objective of this role**

Establish and continuously improve a consistent, resilient, and risk-based network security posture across all global locations, with particular emphasis on secure IT/OT connectivity, effective network segmentation, controlled privileged and third-party access, and rapid containment of network-based threats—without disrupting critical manufacturing operations.

**Basic Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.
* 13–15 years of relevant experience in network engineering and network security, including substantial hands-on experience in enterprise-scale environments.
* Strong experience designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and operating enterprise network security solutions.
Demonstrated experience working across geographically distributed environments and coordinating with global IT and infrastructure teams.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP Security, CCIE Security or equivalent vendor certifications. Current certification names and availability should be validated during recruitment.
* Hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls, firewall policy management, IDS/IPS, VPN, secure remote access, network access control, and network segmentation.
* Experience with SASE/SSE platforms, cloud network security, zero-trust network access, and hybrid enterprise connectivity.
* Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity and OT environments, including Purdue-model concepts, industrial DMZs, secure remote vendor access, and segmentation of manufacturing networks.
* Familiarity with IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-82, and relevant regional regulatory requirements.
* Experience integrating network security telemetry with SIEM/SOC platforms and supporting threat detection, investigation, and incident containment.
* Experience in global manufacturing, industrial machinery, engineering, automotive, chemicals, food processing, or other environments with operationally critical sites.
* Strong troubleshooting, architecture documentation, vendor management, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives across time zones and provide technical guidance to internal teams and service providers.

**Who we are:**

Mold-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.

Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.
  
  
EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

 **Job Description**

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer at Nexthink, you will be responsible for the security of our internal environment. You won't just be monitoring logs; you will be architecting the security fabric that enables our rapid growth.

Working in close partnership with IT, business teams and, partnering with our Cloud and Application Security teams, you will secure the identity, devices, and applications used by "Nexthinkers" worldwide. You will own the security of a complex SaaS ecosystem, and lead detection and response for the corporate environment.

**What You Will Do**

**Identity-Centric Security Architecture**

* Contribute to the design and support the implementation of passwordless authentication and Zero Trust principles.
* Manage secure provisioning and lifecycle management, ensuring least-privilege access across all business systems.
* Partner with HR and IT to streamline onboarding/offboarding workflows, ensuring timely access revocation and auditability.

**Endpoint & Infrastructure Security**

* Define and enforce security baselines for our diverse fleet of endpoints (Windows, macOS) and mobile devices via MDM (Intune/Jamf).
* Manage and tune EDR/XDR solutions to ensure high-fidelity detection on workstations and servers (Windows, Linux, macOS).
* Secure the corporate Azure footprint, ensuring proper configuration of subscriptions, networking, and resources distinct from our production product environment.
* Proactively identify and mitigate security risks in our corporate environment, conducting regular security assessments and vulnerability scans.
* Coordinate vulnerability management and patch management
* Collaborate with IT to automate endpoint compliance checks and remediation workflows.

**Security Engineering**

* Support the development and maintenance of Infrastructure-as-Code.
* Ensure hardening and compliance of endpoints and servers.

**SaaS Security & Integration**

* Assess and secure third-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Salesforce apps, browser extensions, productivity tools) to prevent data leakage and over-privileged access.
* Collaborate with Legal and Compliance to vet new vendors and tools.
* Configure and maintain CASB and DLP policies to safeguard sensitive corporate data without hindering productivity.

**Detection, Response & Automation**

* Lead incident response activities for corporate security events (phishing, malware, lost devices).
* Develop automation scripts (Python/PowerShell) and workflows (SOAR) to automate manual security tasks, evidence collection, and response actions.
* Proactively hunt for threats within the corporate network and identity providers.
* Develop incident response playbooks including technology specific procedures and forensics collection

**Audits and Compliance**

* Design and implement security controls to safeguard corporate resources, including endpoints, data storage, networking, computing and identity and access management.
* Support and automate evidence collection for audits.

**Culture & Collaboration**

* Act as the primary security liaison to the IT Department and business teams, helping them build security into their operations (DevSecOps for IT).
* Design and deliver technical security training and awareness campaigns for engineering and business teams.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 7+ years of hands-on experience in Corporate Security, IT Security Engineering, or a SOC role in a cloud-first environment.
* Endpoint Mastery: Experience hardening operating systems (macOS/Windows) and managing security via MDM/UEM tools.
* Vulnerability management: Proven experience in helping IT and business teams patching systems and infrastructures.
* Coding Skills: Proficiency in Python and Terraform for automating APIs and security workflows.
* Security Ops: Proven experience with EDR tools and SIEM log analysis.
* Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence and drive security best practices across non-security teams.
* Experience with security awareness training platforms and phishing simulation tools.

**Bonus Points**

* Identity Expertise: Deep technical knowledge of Okta and Microsoft Entra ID (Authentication policy, Conditional Access, SSO, SCIM, OIDC/SAML).
* Experience implementing FIDO2/WebAuthn (Passwordless).
* Proficient in PowerShell.
* Familiarity with compliance standards (ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2, FedRAMP)
* Experience securing Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS) specifically for internal/corporate workloads.

**Why Join Nexthink Security?**

* Impact: You will report directly into the CISO organization and have a tangible impact on the daily lives of employees and the safety of the company.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge security projects, with visibility and support from executive leadership.
* Technology: We use top-tier security stacks. You won’t be fighting with legacy on-premise hardware; we are cloud-native.
* Culture: We value "Security as an Enabler," not a blocker. You will work in a supportive, highly technical environment in our Madrid hub

  
**Additional Information**

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

* Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* Health insurance through our partnership with Bajaj, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.
* Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
* ️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering.
* Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
* ️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.
* New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.
* Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.
* Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Senior Application Security EngineerThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**About Our Cybersecurity Team**
--------------------------------

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading technology companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced **Application Security Engineer** to join our team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring an Application Security Engineer to build how our enterprise secures software, from first commit to production. This is not a role for running scans and filing tickets. You will design the guardrails, automation, and AI-powered tooling that let engineering teams ship securely by default, and you will prove they work with data.

You will work as a peer to engineering, architecture, and DevOps leaders and own outcomes across secure SDLC, CI/CD and supply chain integrity, WAF/WAAP and API protection, and AI/LLM security. The right person sees a recurring problem and builds the capability that makes it go away.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

### **Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Build security into the SDLC as paved roads, so the secure path is the easiest path for every engineering team.
* Define the secure coding standards and reference patterns that teams across the enterprise build against.
* Build the vulnerability prioritization capability that shows where real risk sits across code, pipelines, and deployed services, and drive remediation to measurable closure.
* Establish a threat modeling practice for applications, APIs, and delivery pipelines that scale beyond a single team.

### **CI/CD & software supply chain security**

* Architect the security control layer for our CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps) so every pipeline inherits it by default.
* Design the automated testing pipeline that runs SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning on every build, tuned for signal over noise.
* Build the automation that keeps our attack surface visible: API discovery, dependency scanning, SBOM generation, and secrets detection.

### **AI/LLM security & AI-powered automation**

* Build reusable AI agent skills and workflows inside CI/CD (e.g., agentic coding tools, MCP-based integrations) that review every pull request for insecure patterns, authN/authZ gaps, secrets exposure, and risky dependency changes, and deliver CWE/OWASP-mapped findings developers can act on.
* Build AI-driven security testing that generates targeted test cases (API abuse cases, fuzzing inputs, prompt-injection and jailbreak suites), triages SAST/SCA/DAST results to cut false positives and proposes remediation PRs for human review.
* Define the guardrails AI agents operate under our pipelines: least-privilege tokens, human-in-the-loop approval, output-accuracy evaluation, and audit logging.
* Build the AI-specific scanning capability that catches insecure LLM orchestration patterns before they ship.
* Establish a reusable threat modeling approach for RAG architectures and autonomous agents.
* Define the framework for secure AI adoption in enterprise applications, covering data security, access controls, model input/output handling, and misuse prevention.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph and similar orchestration frameworks

### **Partnership & enablement**

* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives end-to-end, taking ownership of tasks, deliverables, and outcomes.
* Shape product, platform, and DevOps roadmaps as trusted advisors, translating technical risk into business decisions.
* Choose, implement, and prove the tooling that closes the gaps we have today, with metrics that show the impact.
* Grow security capability inside engineering teams through mentoring secure coding and pipeline practices.
* Help scale the Security Champions program into a self-sustaining network.

**What you need to bring:**
---------------------------

* 6+ years in Application Security, Product Security, or Secure Software Development, with a track record of building capabilities, not only operating them.
* Has designed security controls for CI/CD pipelines and source repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar) at scale.
* Has built and tuned SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning, so developers trust and act on the results.
* Has built and tuned WAF and API protections and driven vulnerability remediation to closure.
* Applies SLSA and NIST SSDF to design build integrity, including secrets management and artifact signing.
* Has designed security controls in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10 (Web & API), CWE, and secure coding practices.
* Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

### **Preferred**

* Has built LLM-powered developer or security tooling, including prompt/skill design, tool and MCP integration, and evaluation of output quality and false-positive rates.
* Has implemented signing and provenance with Sigstore/Cosign or similar tooling.
* Integrate SBOM generation and SCA into CI/CD workflows.
* Has deployed runtime protection (API security platforms, RASP, container EDR).
* Has built GitOps, IaC scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation), and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Has led or shaped response to software supply chain or dependency poisoning incidents.
* Relevant certifications: OSWE, CSSLP, GPCS, GWEB, GCSA.
* Writes production-quality code in at least one language (Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript/Node.js) to build automation and tooling.

### **Soft skills**

* Influences developers, DevOps engineers, and leadership through clear communication and well-built tooling, not mandates.
* Automation-first: if a task happens twice, you build the capability that removes it.
* Measures success by outcomes, balancing security with delivery velocity.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**
