title: AI/ML Manager
description:
**Job Description: AI/ML Manager – Enterprise AI Implementation**

**Location:** Malaysia  
**Candidate Sourcing:** India  
**Experience:** 8–15+ years overall experience, including significant experience leading AI/ML initiatives  
**Role Level:** Senior Manager / AI Transformation Manager / Head of AI Implementation (designation based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **AI/ML Manager with proven experience in enterprise-level Artificial Intelligence implementation** to lead the strategy, planning, development, deployment, and scaling of AI-driven solutions across business functions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of AI/ML technical knowledge, enterprise technology leadership, stakeholder management, and program delivery experience. This role requires a professional who has successfully taken AI initiatives beyond proof of concept (PoC) and pilots into production environments, delivering measurable business value, operational efficiency, and scalable enterprise capabilities.

The candidate will work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, IT teams, data engineering teams, and external technology partners to identify AI opportunities, establish implementation roadmaps, and drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI solutions.

Candidates must have demonstrable experience managing large-scale AI implementations in complex business or enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop and execute enterprise AI strategies aligned with organizational business objectives.
* Identify high-impact opportunities for AI/ML adoption across business functions, operations, products, and customer-facing applications.
* Define AI implementation roadmaps, investment priorities, business cases, and delivery milestones.
* Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, risk, and expected return on investment.
* Lead the transition from AI experimentation and proof of concept to production-grade enterprise implementations.
* Establish standards, frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI adoption.

**2. Enterprise AI Implementation & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of AI/ML solutions across multiple business units or enterprise functions.
* Oversee AI programs from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, integration, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage large-scale AI implementation projects involving multiple teams, technology platforms, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Ensure AI solutions integrate effectively with existing enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and business workflows.
* Drive the deployment of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable AI systems.
* Track implementation progress, resolve delivery challenges, manage dependencies, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* Establish clear success metrics and measure the business impact of deployed AI solutions.

**3. Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Adoption**

* Lead the evaluation and implementation of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Drive the adoption of enterprise AI applications such as intelligent assistants, knowledge management systems, document intelligence, conversational AI, workflow automation, and decision-support systems.
* Oversee initiatives involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, AI agents, model orchestration, and integration with internal knowledge repositories, where relevant.
* Evaluate commercial AI platforms, foundation models, and open-source technologies based on business needs, security, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Define approaches for responsible LLM deployment, model evaluation, output quality, and risk management.
* Establish appropriate controls for sensitive enterprise data, access permissions, hallucination risks, and human oversight.

**4. AI/ML Program & Team Management**

* Lead and manage cross-functional teams comprising AI/ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, software developers, architects, and business analysts.
* Define project scope, resource plans, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and governance structures.
* Build and mentor high-performing AI teams and develop internal capabilities for sustainable AI adoption.
* Manage external implementation partners, consultants, and technology vendors where applicable.
* Establish delivery standards, review mechanisms, performance indicators, and escalation processes.
* Communicate program progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior management and executive stakeholders.

**5. Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance**

* Work with enterprise architects, IT leaders, and data leaders to define scalable AI solution architectures.
* Guide decisions regarding cloud-based AI platforms, data infrastructure, model deployment, enterprise integration, and technology selection.
* Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, application security, infrastructure, and data management standards.
* Promote appropriate MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
* Establish governance processes for model validation, performance monitoring, versioning, and production support.

**6. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Establish governance frameworks for enterprise AI implementation and adoption.
* Ensure AI solutions adhere to applicable data privacy, information security, regulatory, and organizational policies.
* Address risks related to data leakage, model bias, explainability, reliability, intellectual property, and unauthorized AI usage.
* Work with security, compliance, legal, and risk teams to define appropriate controls and approval processes.
* Promote responsible, transparent, and auditable AI practices across the organization.

**7. Business Value & Transformation**

* Partner with business leaders to redesign processes and identify opportunities for AI-led transformation.
* Quantify business benefits, including productivity improvements, cost optimization, faster decision-making, and enhanced customer experience.
* Develop business cases and establish KPIs to measure AI adoption, operational impact, and return on investment.
* Drive change management, user adoption, training, and organizational readiness for AI-enabled workflows.
* Present implementation outcomes, strategic recommendations, and progress reports to executive leadership.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Approximately **8–15+ years of overall technology, data, digital transformation, or AI-related experience**, with the level adjusted to the complexity of prior enterprise implementations.
* Significant experience managing or leading enterprise AI/ML implementation programs.
* Demonstrated success taking AI initiatives from business requirements and PoCs into production deployment and scaled adoption.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams and complex technology delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, enterprise data platforms, cloud technologies, and modern AI architectures.
* Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders, IT leadership, and executive management.
* Proven ability to connect technology investments with measurable business outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills & Competencies**

* Enterprise AI implementation and transformation.
* AI/ML program and project management.
* AI strategy, use-case prioritization, and roadmap development.
* Production deployment and scaling of AI solutions.
* Stakeholder and executive management.
* Enterprise solution architecture and systems integration.
* Team leadership, resource planning, and delivery governance.
* Business case development, KPI tracking, and ROI measurement.
* AI risk management, governance, privacy, and security awareness.

**Preferred Technical Exposure**

Candidates should have practical implementation or leadership exposure to several of the following:

* Enterprise Generative AI and LLM platforms.
* RAG-based applications, enterprise search, and AI assistants.
* Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and predictive analytics.
* Microsoft Azure AI, AWS AI services, or Google Cloud AI.
* Enterprise data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and data engineering.
* MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, and deployment automation.
* AI application integration with ERP, CRM, enterprise knowledge systems, and business applications.
* AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent process automation.
* Commercial AI platforms and open-source AI ecosystems.

**Key Success Criteria**

The successful candidate will demonstrate a track record of:

* Delivering at least one or more significant AI implementations in a complex enterprise environment.
* Moving AI solutions from experimentation to production and sustained business use.
* Managing multiple stakeholders, teams, and technology dependencies.
* Establishing effective AI governance, security, and operational controls.
* Demonstrating measurable business value from AI investments.
* Driving adoption of AI solutions across teams, departments, or business units.

**Location & Relocation**

**Work Location:** Malaysia  
**Target Candidate Pool:** Experienced professionals currently based in India and willing to relocate to Malaysia.

Candidates must be open to international relocation and working with multicultural, geographically distributed teams. Relocation arrangements and work authorization will be discussed during the recruitment process.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strategic yet execution-oriented technology leader who understands both the business and technical dimensions of enterprise AI.

The ideal candidate is not limited to AI research, model development, or proof-of-concept experimentation. They should have direct ownership or substantial leadership responsibility for **implementing, integrating, deploying, governing, and scaling AI solutions in a real enterprise environment**.

Experience in enterprise digital transformation, consulting-led AI implementations, large technology programs, or AI platform adoption will be highly valued.

**Application Requirements**

Interested candidates should provide:

* Updated CV highlighting enterprise AI implementations.
* Total years of experience and relevant AI leadership experience.
* Examples of AI programs delivered, including business problem, solution, implementation scale, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience with production deployment, enterprise integration, and AI governance.
* Team size, budget, and program ownership, where applicable.
* Current location, notice period, and compensation expectations.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.

Pay: ₹405,000.00 - ₹1,670,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

description:

* Guide the design, implementation, and operation of technical, physical, and administrative controls that help protect Blackbaud’s sensitive information systems.
* Evaluate new software designs and acquired software for alignment with applicable compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with Security Operations, Security Engineering, and Risk Management to develop remediation plans and successfully facilitate assessments and audits.
* Strengthen Blackbaud’s compliance program by documenting lessons learned, maintaining improvement opportunities, and translating newly published PCI Council and AICPA requirements into clear, actionable guidance.

**What you'll bring**

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Center of Excellence)
description:
We are looking for a senior OT cybersecurity engineer to join the Grid Automation Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence (COE), a new central team that owns how cybersecurity is executed on GA projects worldwide.
  
  
The role is hands-on. You will design, build, configure, test and optionally commission security solutions on complex utility and industrial projects. You will then turn that work into the standards, templates and training that regional teams use on every project that follows.
  
  
You will be the recognized technical owner for a set of solutions in the GA cybersecurity portfolio, covering areas such as firewalls, OT network monitoring, secure remote access, identity, PKI, SIEM, etc... Regional teams will come to you when a project goes beyond their depth.
  
  
You will also make execution faster and more consistent. That means automating repeatable build and verification work in PowerShell, and using frontier AI models to shorten documentation, requirements mapping and configuration review, while engineering judgement and the protection of customer data stay firmly with you.

**Job Description**
===================

**About the Cybersecurity COE**

The COE gives GA a single owner for cybersecurity execution standards and process across all regions. It reports into the GA OT Cybersecurity Product Line and covers five functions:

* Delivery of complex project scope, and specialist support to regions on demand.
* A standard execution toolkit: security plans, reference architectures, checklists, templates and automation scripts that regions can apply directly.
* A structured competency programme of periodic technical and non-technical training.
* Formal cybersecurity reviews at key project milestones.
* Regulatory intelligence on IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA and regional mandates, so execution teams are ready for compliance before customers ask.
  

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Project execution**

* Lead the cybersecurity workstream on Tier 1 projects end to end: requirements review, security architecture, detailed design, build, configuration, FAT, SAT, commissioning and handover.
* Work hands-on in staging and at customer sites: build and harden Windows and Linux servers, and configure firewalls, Active Directory, PKI, KDC, network intrusion detection, SIEM and syslog, application control, backup and recovery, and secure remote access.
* Produce the project security deliverables: security plan, zone and conduit model, risk assessment, hardening records, test procedures and reports, and the security handover package.
* Map customer requirements to contract scope early, flag deviations as they arise, and give project managers the technical basis for change orders.
* Support tender and project teams with scope definition and effort estimates for complex cybersecurity scope.
  

  

**Execution standards and toolkit**

* Act as the technical owner (Expert) for an assigned set of COE competencies. Set the reference configuration for each and keep it current with product and partner releases.
* Build the GA execution toolkit as a by-product of delivery: reference architectures, configuration baselines, build checklists, PowerShell scripts, how-to guides, test procedures and templates.
* Run formal design and configuration reviews at project milestones, so misconfigurations are found before FAT and handover rather than by the customer.
* Capture lessons learned at project close and feed them back into the toolkit.
  

  

**Automation and AI-assisted execution**

* Write and maintain PowerShell scripts and modules that automate repeatable execution tasks: Windows Server and workstation hardening, Active Directory and Group Policy build, account and group provisioning, certificate enrolment, audit policy and log forwarding setup, and backup job configuration.
* Build automated checks that compare as-built systems against the COE reference baselines and produce the evidence for milestone reviews, FAT and SAT, so verification no longer depends on manual screenshots and spot checks.
* Use frontier AI models to speed up execution work: drafting and reviewing security plans, test procedures and as-built documents; mapping customer specifications against IEC 62443-3-3 requirements; analysing firewall rule bases, configuration exports and logs; and writing and reviewing scripts.
* Use AI only within GE Vernova approved platforms and data-handling rules. Customer configurations, network drawings and logs from critical infrastructure stay inside approved boundaries, and an engineer verifies every AI output before it reaches a customer or a live system.
* Turn proven scripts, prompts and AI-assisted workflows into toolkit assets, so regional engineers get the same gains on Tier 2 and Tier 3 projects.
  

  

**Competency building**

* Design and deliver structured technical training for regional engineers, from foundation to advanced level, on the solutions you own.
* Coach regional engineers on live projects, so that project types can move from Tier 1 to Tier 2, and from Tier 2 to Tier 3.
* Maintain independent working capability (Backup) in competencies owned by COE colleagues, so the team keeps delivering when one person is unavailable.
  

  

**Specialist support and regulatory intelligence**

* Provide on-demand support to regional teams on design questions, site troubleshooting and escalations.
* Support patch management, vulnerability assessment and incident response engagements on GA-delivered systems, working with Product Security.
* Track IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and regional mandates, and translate new requirements into execution checklists and deliverables.
* Help regional teams answer customer compliance questions that arise during project execution.
  

  

**Product and partner feedback**

* Feed field experience back to Product Management and R&D: integration issues, recurring defects and gaps in the portfolio.
* Support validation and first deployments of new GA cybersecurity solutions as they come through NPI.
* Work with technology partners on integration, technical escalations and joint validation.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
* 8+ years in industrial automation or the energy sector, including at least 5 years delivering OT cybersecurity hands-on on customer projects, from design through commissioning.
* Applied knowledge of IEC 62443 on real projects, in particular 3-2 (risk assessment, zones and conduits), 3-3 (system security requirements and security levels) and 2-4 (service provider requirements).
* Working knowledge of NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and NIST guidance, and how each translates into project deliverables.
* Expert-level, hands-on depth in at least three of the following areas, and working capability in most of the rest:
  + Next-generation firewalls (Fortinet preferred)
  + OT network intrusion detection and monitoring (Nozomi, Dragos or similar)
  + Secure remote access for industrial systems (Xona or similar)
  + Active Directory, Group Policy, RADIUS and LDAP
  + Public key infrastructure and certificate lifecycle management
  + SIEM and syslog collection (Splunk or similar)
  + Centralised security management platforms
  + Application control and host intrusion prevention (Trellix or similar)
  + Backup and disaster recovery
  + Windows and Linux server build, hardening and virtualisation
  + Hardening of IEDs, RTUs, gateways and other field devices
* Sound understanding of substation and grid automation (protection and control, RTUs, gateways, SCADA and EMS) and the protocols that run them: IEC 61850, DNP3, IEC 60870-5-104 and Modbus.
* Working proficiency in PowerShell for Windows Server and Active Directory administration: the ActiveDirectory and GroupPolicy modules, remoting, error handling and logging, and running signed scripts under the restricted execution policies typical of OT environments.
* Practical, regular use of frontier AI models (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot) in engineering work, with the judgement to check outputs, catch errors and keep sensitive customer data out of unapproved tools.
* A track record of producing project security documentation that customers and auditors accept.
* Experience training and mentoring engineers.
* Willingness to travel 20–40%, including extended site stays, and to join calls across time zones.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert (or its specialist certificates), CISSP, Fortinet FCP or FCSS (formerly NSE 4 and NSE 7), Splunk Core Certified, or vendor training on Nozomi or Dragos.
* Experience as the cybersecurity lead on large utility, data centre or industrial projects with multiple vendors and a demanding customer.
* Experience building AI-assisted engineering workflows, such as structured prompt libraries, agent-based tools or API integrations, for document generation, requirements mapping or log triage.
* Configuration-as-code and scripting discipline: PowerShell DSC or Ansible, Pester tests for scripts, Git version control, and Bash or Python for Linux systems.
* Writes clear, precise documentation. A checklist or procedure written by this person can be followed by an engineer who has never met them.
* Teaches well. Can explain a design decision to a junior engineer and defend it to a customer's security team.
* Holds scope boundaries with customers firmly and professionally, and understands that scope discipline protects both schedule and margin.
* Works comfortably in a global organisation with people from many cultures and backgrounds. Additional languages are an advantage.
* Takes ownership. Treats a problem found on one project as a gap in the toolkit, and fixes the toolkit.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

title: IT Generalist – Ruah Tech Solutions (Embedded with Impact Investment Platform)
description:
**Role summary**

As an IT Generalist, you will be employed by Ruah Tech Solutions and embedded into a next-generation decentralised impact investment platform to manage, secure, and optimize core IT systems and infrastructure. With an automation-first approach, you will ensure operational resilience, user productivity, and compliance across business-critical platforms, including business intelligence tools like Power BI, during rapid growth.

**About the platform (client)**

Our client is a decentralised impact investment firm that transforms overlooked real-world assets into shared prosperity for communities around the world. By securing and tokenising assets such as land, water, timber, agriculture, and other commodities, they create transparent, blockchain-enabled governance models that keep financial sovereignty in the hands of local stakeholders while opening access to retail, institutional, and community investors. Built on institutional-grade compliance and on-chain accountability, their platform uses a governance token to connect capital with high-impact projects across emerging markets, aligning long-term economic growth with measurable social and environmental outcomes.

**About the engagement**

You will operate as part of an Embedded Capability Team that moves in lockstep with the client’s internal rhythms, working as a true extension of their in-house team rather than a separate vendor track. The engagement is designed for long-term capability building, shared ownership of outcomes, and deep domain expertise in sustainability, impact, and financial data over time.

**Key responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain core company platforms including cloud workspaces (AWS Workspaces, Google Workspace), collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, email systems), and business intelligence platforms like Power BI.
* Provision and administer user accounts, access controls, and permissions across all systems, including Power BI workspaces, datasets, and gateways, with strong adherence to least-privilege and ISO 27001 compliance standards.

* Automate routine operational tasks (user onboarding/offboarding, system backups, compliance reporting, Power BI refresh schedules, software deployments) using scripting and workflow tools.
* Document IT processes, configurations, and standard operating procedures, including BI data governance and integration patterns, to ensure knowledge transfer and operational continuity.
* Collaborate with business users, analysts, and engineering teams to resolve technical issues and support feature delivery without operational disruption.

**Required skills and experience**

* Strong hands-on experience administering cloud workspaces, productivity platforms, and business intelligence tools like Power BI (workspaces, gateways, data sources, DAX/refresh management).
* Proficiency managing collaboration and business systems (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, CRM integrations, financial/ERP tools, Microsoft 365 ecosystem).

* Practical knowledge of IT security fundamentals (IAM, endpoint protection, firewalls, encryption, vulnerability scanning, ISO 27001 compliance) applied to BI and data platforms.
* Experience with Windows/macOS endpoint management, Active Directory/Entra ID, and mobile device management (MDM).
* Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Power BI admin monitoring) and automation scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
* Experience supporting distributed teams across time zones with remote-first IT operations.
* Typically 3–5+ years of systems administration or IT operations experience in growth-stage companies.

**Preferred skills**

* Experience supporting fintech, blockchain, ESG/impact organizations, or BI-heavy environments with compliance and security requirements.
* Exposure to developer tooling support (GitHub, Jira, Confluence) alongside business user platforms.
* Advanced automation skills using tools like Ansible, Terraform (basic), Microsoft Intune, or Power Automate for BI workflows.

* Hands-on experience with AWS core services (Workspaces, EC2, RDS, S3) used by business and BI teams.
* Comfort working across cultures and time zones with excellent written and verbal communication.

**How we work**

You will join a team that values curiosity, thoughtful service, and mutual support, where IT professionals take ownership of both their own growth and the operational outcomes they deliver. The role suits someone who is energized by solving real user problems, including empowering analysts with reliable BI tools, cares about the business impact of reliable systems, and wants to build long-term relationships with both Ruah Tech Solutions and the client’s teams.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong track record managing IT operations, BI platform administration, system integrations, and troubleshooting in dynamic environments.

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to work on meaningful, impact-driven technology that connects finance, data, IoT, business intelligence, and communities.

title: Edge Software & Security Engineer
description:
### **Role Summary**

Design and build the software foundations that power secure, scalable edge platforms. This role combines edge software skills, platform development, and secure by design strategies to ensure devices can be deployed, updated, managed, and trusted throughout their lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop edge platform services, frameworks, and tooling for embedded and edge environments
* Build secure-by-design platform capabilities including secure boot, cryptographic services, trusted storage, and device identity
* Design and implement resilient OTA update systems for firmware, operating systems, and edge applications
* Develop device lifecycle management capabilities including provisioning, onboarding, configuration management, and retirement
* Implement supply chain security controls including firmware signing, SBOM generation, artifact provenance, and build integrity
* Build and secure CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, and software delivery toolchains for edge platforms
* Integrate TPMs, TEEs, and secure elements to establish hardware-rooted trust
* Implement device attestation, integrity validation, and remote trust verification mechanisms
* Develop automation, observability, diagnostics, and fleet management capabilities for large-scale edge deployments
* Partner with hardware, firmware, cloud, and product teams to define platform architecture, security requirements, and threat models

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in edge, embedded, platform, or security engineering
* Strong software development experience in Python, Go, C/C++, or Rust
* Experience building software for optimized containerized apps, embedded Linux, or edge computing environments
* Hands-on experience with secure boot, TPMs, secure elements, key management, and hardware-rooted trust
* Knowledge of OTA update architectures, software packaging, and fleet deployment strategies
* Experience implementing secure software supply chains, code signing, SBOMs, and artifact provenance
* Familiarity with containerized edge workloads and orchestration technologies
* Understanding of device identity, attestation, lifecycle management, and zero-trust principles
* Familiarity with operating CI/CD pipelines and modern SDLC practices
* Proficiency with Git and familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and collaborative engineering workflows

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Kubernetes, K3s, Talos Edge, KubeEdge or similar edge orchestration platforms
* Experience developing platform SDKs, APIs, and developer tooling
* Familiarity with confidential computing, trusted execution environments, or remote attestation services
* Exposure to managing large-scale fleets of connected devices
* Knowledge of cloud-to-edge architectures and hybrid deployment models

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**Entity:**

Technology  

**Job Family Group:**

Research & Technology Group  

**Job Description:**

**Who we are**
--------------

  
  

**About bp/team**
=================

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We build all the technology that powers bp’s businesses, from upstream energy production to downstream energy delivery to our customers. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. We encourage our teams to adapt quickly by using native AWS and Azure services, including serverless, and enable them to pick the best technology for a given problem. This is meant to empower our software and platform engineers while allowing them to learn and develop themselves.

  
  

**Role Purpose**
================

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for assuring the quality, reliability and usability of digital platforms and services supporting the Corporate Affairs portfolio. The role combines hands-on manual testing with test automation to validate that new features, integrations, fixes and releases meet business, user, technical and operational requirements.

  
  

Working closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Technical Delivery Leads, Software Engineers, suppliers and business stakeholders, the role embeds quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. It plans and implements functional and non-functional testing, builds reusable automated tests, manages defects and provides clear evidence to support release decisions and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Scope & Scale**
=================

**Platform focus**

Supports Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services, including DCP, Brand Portal, global web, content, campaign, analytics, integrations and operational support capabilities.

**Testing coverage**

Covers manual and automated functional, integration, regression, API, end-to-end, smoke, exploratory and release testing.

**Non-functional quality**

Supports accessibility, usability, cross-browser, responsive, performance, security and operational-readiness validation.

**Delivery lifecycle**

Contributes from discovery and requirements refinement through build, test, release, production verification and post-release improvement.

**Quality engineering**

Builds reusable automation, quality gates, test evidence, defect insight and risk-based recommendations that improve release confidence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Test Strategy, Planning & Analysis**
--------------------------------------

* Contribute to test strategies and create proportionate test plans based on scope, quality risks, dependencies and release objectives.

* Review requirements, user stories, designs and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguity, testability concerns and required coverage.

* Define test scenarios, test cases, test data, environment needs, entry and exit criteria and traceability to requirements.

* Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on business-critical journeys, integrations and operational risks.

* Provide clear test estimates, progress reporting, quality metrics and evidence for delivery governance and release decisions.

* Develop reusable test libraries, page objects, fixtures, utilities and test data aligned to sound software engineering principles.

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establish quality checks that provide rapid, repeatable feedback.

**Collaboration & Quality Culture**
-----------------------------------

* Collaborate with product, analysis, design, development, operations, security, privacy and supplier teams throughout delivery.

* Champion shift-left testing by engaging early in discovery, refinement and technical design discussions.

* Promote shared ownership of quality and support engineers in improving unit, component and integration testing.

* Maintain test documentation, evidence, dashboards and reusable knowledge assets.

* Share testing practices and support continuous improvement across bp and supplier delivery teams.

  
  

**Skills & Experience**
=======================

* Experience testing digital products, web platforms, CMS solutions, APIs, integrations or cloud-based services using both manual and automated approaches.

* Solid understanding of test design techniques, exploratory testing, regression testing, defect management and requirements traceability.

* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and API automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent.

* Coding or scripting experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Python or a comparable language, with Git-based version control.

* Experience integrating automated testing into Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD platforms.

* Understanding of accessibility, responsive, cross-browser, performance, security and operational-readiness testing.

* Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineers and suppliers.

* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide evidence-based quality recommendations.

* Early identification of defects, gaps and release risks, reducing rework and production issues.

* Timely, evidence-based quality reporting that supports informed release decisions.

title: Enterprise Applications - Support Specialist
description:
Blink Charging Co. (Nasdaq: BLNK) is a leading owner, operator, and provider of electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment and networked EV charging services. We're on a mission to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles by deploying thousands of charging stations across the United States and around the world.

**What We Do:**

Blink offers both residential and commercial EV charging equipment and connectivity to the Blink Network—a comprehensive cloud-based software that operates, manages, and tracks our EV charging stations and payment processing. Our charging solutions serve a diverse range of customers including multi-family residential and commercial properties, airports, colleges, municipalities, parking garages, shopping malls, retail parking, and more.

**Why Blink:**

* **Industry Leader:** We're at the forefront of the EV charging revolution, building critical infrastructure for a sustainable future
* **Innovation-Driven:** We continuously develop cutting-edge technology to improve the EV charging experience
* **Growth Opportunity:** Join a rapidly expanding company in one of the world's fastest-growing industries
* **Mission That Matters:** Every day, we're helping reduce carbon emissions and create a cleaner planet

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Enterprise Applications Support Specialist serves as a primary technical enabler and troubleshooter across Blink Charging’s enterprise applications ecosystem. The role supports NetSuite and Salesforce as primary platforms, with additional support for Ramp, Jira, and Confluence. This position partners with Enterprise Application Leads to deliver enhancements, train users, resolve issues, support releases, and maintain reliable day-to-day operations.

**Here’s What You’ll Do**
=========================

**Feature Enablement and Implementation**
-----------------------------------------

* Partner with Application Leads to design, test, and implement new features and enhancements.
* Develop user materials, deliver training, and support adoption of new capabilities and processes.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing and conduct thorough sandbox validation before production rollout.
* Support cutover, data migration, go-live, and post-implementation activities.
* Create and maintain implementation documentation, guides, FAQs, and knowledge content in Confluence.
* Gather user feedback and communicate improvement opportunities to Application Leads.

**Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution**
----------------------------------------

* Diagnose and resolve application, configuration, permission, data, workflow, and integration issues across supported systems.
* Perform root cause analysis and document clear findings, resolutions, and prevention recommendations.
* Troubleshoot cross-platform integration failures, including NetSuite-to-Salesforce and Ramp-to-NetSuite data flows.
* Escalate complex issues with complete analysis, evidence, business impact, and recommended next steps.
* Monitor logs, performance, data syncs, and system health to identify issues before they affect users.

**System Maintenance and Operational Support**
----------------------------------------------

* Manage routine administration, including user access, roles, permissions, onboarding, and offboarding.
* Perform recurring maintenance, data cleanup, report updates, documentation, and runbook upkeep.
* Audit access controls and support adherence to data governance and security policies.
* Monitor integrations and support critical business cycles such as month-end close, quarterly reporting, and annual reconciliation.
* Track application performance and adoption indicators and recommend practical improvements.

**Cross-Application Collaboration and Discovery**
-------------------------------------------------

* Support enterprise application integrations and data flows across the technology ecosystem.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements based on user feedback, issue patterns, and operational observations.
* Share knowledge with support and delivery teams and contribute to a reusable knowledge base.

**What You Bring to the Table**
===============================

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* 4-6+ years in enterprise application support, administration, or technical analyst roles.
* Hands-on support experience with at least two enterprise applications, including ERP, CRM, or related business systems.
* Experience with configuration, workflows, custom fields, permissions, user administration, testing, and release support.
* Basic to intermediate SQL and data querying skills, with the ability to interpret logs and error messages.
* Experience using ticketing, documentation, and knowledge management tools.
* Understanding of application integrations, role-based security, data flows, and common business processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and expense management.

**Application Knowledge**
-------------------------

* Primary platforms: NetSuite financials, order management, fixed assets, multi-subsidiary management, and workflows; Salesforce Sales Cloud, customer and opportunity management, integrations, and reporting.
* Secondary platforms: Ramp expense and approval workflows; Jira project and issue tracking; Confluence documentation and knowledge management.
* Ability to learn new application features independently and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Proactive ownership and self-directed learning
* Methodical troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences
* Patience, professionalism, and service orientation
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation
* Prioritization across concurrent incidents, requests, and projects
* Collaboration with Application Leads and business teams

India (fully remote or hybrid)

Full-time

Mid-Level (4-6+ years in enterprise application support or administration)

Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**About the Role**
------------------

Evolent is seeking a **Senior Quality Engineer** to play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and security of our healthcare technology solutions. This role combines hands-on testing expertise with quality leadership, focusing on test strategy, automation, process improvement, and collaboration across engineering teams. The ideal candidate is passionate about building quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle and driving continuous improvement in testing practices.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive **test plans, test strategies, and quality assurance processes** for complex software applications.
* Lead the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of **test automation frameworks** to improve testing efficiency, reliability, and coverage.
* Conduct **manual and automated testing**, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and security testing.
* Create and maintain automated test suites for **web applications, APIs, databases, and microservices**.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects while collaborating closely with development teams for timely resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Drive **continuous improvement initiatives** in testing processes, tools, frameworks, and methodologies.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to define quality standards and acceptance criteria.
* Generate and analyze **quality metrics, test reports, and release-readiness assessments**, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Participate in **requirements reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and product design sessions** to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC.
* Integrate automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines**, establishing quality gates and supporting continuous delivery practices.
* Mentor junior quality engineers and promote best practices in quality engineering, automation, and testing.
* Evaluate emerging testing technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve software quality and team productivity.
* Leverage and promote the use of **AI coding and testing assistants** (e.g., **GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex**) to accelerate test automation development, generate test cases, improve code quality, assist with defect analysis, and enhance engineering productivity while maintaining quality, security, and compliance standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5–8 years of experience** in Software Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, or Test Automation.

* Solid understanding of: **Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)**Functional, regression, integration, performance, and security testingTest automation design patterns and framework architectureAgile/Scrum methodologies
* Experience testing: **Web applicationsREST APIs and microservices**Database systems and data validation processes
* Hands-on experience leveraging **AI coding and testing assistants** (e.g., **GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex**) to accelerate test automation development, generate test cases, improve code quality, perform root-cause analysis, and enhance overall engineering productivity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and quality improvements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor team members and work effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with **performance testing tools** such as JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, or similar.
* Exposure to **security testing tools and practices**.
* Experience testing **cloud-native applications**, preferably on Azure.
* Knowledge of **microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and distributed applications**.

title: Associate Service Desk Analyst
description:
Overview:

**Service Desk Analyst – T1**

Job Description

**Department:**

Security & Corporate IT

**Reports To:**

IT Service Desk Team Lead

**Location:**

India (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Entry/Mid

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Corporate IT team plays a critical role in enabling productivity, supporting our people, and ensuring every employee has the tools they need to do their best work.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Service Desk Analyst serves as the first point of contact for all IT support requests across HealthEdge's global employee base. In this role, you will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve a wide range of hardware, software, and connectivity issues through our ITSM platform (Jira Service Management), by phone, chat, and remote tools. You are part of a follow-the-sun support model, meaning your team's work directly enables colleagues around the world to stay productive regardless of time zone.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious, service-minded IT professional who wants to build a broad foundation across endpoint management, identity, M365, and ITSM — with clear growth paths into T2/T3 support, specialist, or team lead roles.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Incident Intake & Resolution**
--------------------------------

* Serve as the first point of contact for IT support requests via phone, chat, and email
* Triage and categorize incoming tickets, resolving T1-scope issues within defined SLA targets
* Troubleshoot common issues across Windows and macOS endpoints, M365 applications, printers, VPN, and peripherals
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to T2/T3 with full documentation and context
* Follow established runbooks and knowledge base articles to deliver consistent, repeatable resolutions

**Identity & Access Management**
--------------------------------

* Process user onboarding and offboarding requests including account provisioning, deprovisioning, and access modifications
* Manage password resets, MFA enrollment, and basic Okta/Entra ID requests
* Ensure access requests are fulfilled within SLA and properly documented per security policies

**Endpoint & Device Support**
-----------------------------

* Assist employees with setup and configuration of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals
* Support basic imaging, software installation, and configuration tasks as directed by T2/T3
* Coordinate hardware swap or depot processes with the EUC & Asset Management team when replacement is needed

**Documentation & Knowledge**
-----------------------------

* Log all interactions and resolutions accurately and completely in work tracking tools
* Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting new solutions and updating existing articles
* Follow ITIL-aligned processes for incident management, request fulfillment, and escalation

**Communication & Customer Service**
------------------------------------

* Provide clear, timely, and professional communication to end users at all stages of ticket lifecycle
* Set accurate expectations on resolution timelines and proactively communicate delays
* Represent the Corporate IT team positively as the most visible touchpoint for the broader employee base

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 1–3 years of experience in a help desk, service desk, or IT support role
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows 10/11 and macOS endpoints
* Familiarity with M365 applications (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Experience working in a ticketing system
* Basic understanding of Active Directory or Entra ID user and group management
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Customer-first mindset with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with SSO/MFA platforms
* Familiarity with remote support tools
* Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
* CompTIA A+, Microsoft Fundamentals (MD-102), or equivalent certification
* Experience in a global or multi-region IT support environment

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In your first 90 days, you will have completed onboarding and tool training, worked your first live ticket queue, and demonstrated the ability to independently resolve common T1 issues. Within six months, you are consistently meeting SLA targets, contributing to the knowledge base, and beginning to develop familiarity with escalation patterns to T2. Within a year, you are a reliable, trusted member of the team – handling a broad range of T1 issues with minimal escalation and actively contributing to team improvement efforts.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a growing global Corporate IT organization that is building out a structured, tiered support model across India, the Philippines, the US, Mexico, and the UK. The Service Desk Analyst role sits at the foundation of this model – and is the most important customer-facing function in the organization. We take pride in our follow-the-sun coverage model, our investment in tooling and knowledge management, and our commitment to creating clear career paths for team members who want to grow.

*HealthEdge commits to building an environment and culture that supports the diverse representation of our teams. We aspire to have an inclusive workplace. We aspire to be a place where all employees have the opportunity to belong, make an impact and deliver excellent software and services to our customers.*  
  
**Geographic Responsibility:**  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**
* **May require travel dependent on company needs.**

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*  
  
*HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.*

We work side-by-side with our People & Purpose Centers of Excellence — Recruiting, Talent Experience, Total Rewards, HR Partners, Learning, Compliance, Belonging and Diversity, and Global Mobility — to close gaps in data and build reports that help our leaders make informed, real-time decisions. We also build self-service tools so our partners can find answers faster on their own. If you enjoy connecting the dots across many parts of HR and turning complex data into something people can act on, you'll feel right at home here.

**About the Role**

As a **Reporting Analyst** , you will be the person people turn to when they need HR data they can rely on, whether that's building a new report, updating an existing one, or digging into a one-off question. You will own high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests from start to finish, helping requesters shape raw data into a clear story they can bring to their own audience. This role touches nearly every area of HR, including recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers, so you will build broad knowledge of how HR data connects across the business. You will also look for ways to make reporting simpler and more enjoyable for everyone who relies on it.
  
In this role, you will:

* Respond to HR data requests spanning recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers
* Be responsible for audits requested by any team across the business, ensuring the underlying data is accurate, complete, and compliant
* Build new reports and update or troubleshoot existing ones in Workday
* Provide attentive, high-touch support for high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests, helping requesters interpret and present their data
* Apply strong data security, accuracy, governance, and standardization practices to every report you deliver
* Prioritize and manage a high volume of requests with competing deadlines
* Create self-service resources that help HR partners find answers faster on their own

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in HR reporting, analytics, or a related data role
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday Reporting (Workday HCM experience is a plus)

**Other Qualifications**

* Able to turn complex HR data into a clear story that helps business leaders make decisions
* Skilled at cleaning, organizing, and combining data from multiple HR systems, with strong attention to data security, accuracy, and governance
* Broad knowledge of HR functions and terminology across areas such as recruiting, total rewards, learning, and compliance
* Attentive and responsive when supporting internal customers, even under tight deadlines
Organized and able to juggle multiple requests and deadlines in a high-volume environment  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

title: Service Desk Analyst – APAC
description:

You'll take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving hardware, software, account access, and mobile device issues, partnering with Desktop Support, global IT teams, and external vendors to drive solutions when escalation is needed.

Success in this role means combining technical expertise, a customer-first mindset, and a relentless focus on keeping our teams connected and productive.

Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of

* Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in supporting users in multiple countries

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Network Security Engineer

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
Technology is core to the health and growth of our business. The firm's active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. Millennium's Information Security team protects the firm's people, data, and technology across a complex, fast-moving global trading environment, partnering closely with technology, trading, and business stakeholders to embed security into every aspect of our global operations. As the firm accelerates its use of artificial intelligence, the team is equally focused on applying AI in innovative, entrepreneurial ways to strengthen our own defenses. Within that organization, the Network Security team designs and defends the network infrastructure connecting Millennium's global offices, data centers, and cloud environments, spanning perimeter controls such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, NDR, NAC, proxies, email security, and DNS security, as well as the detection and automation stack behind them, including the security data lake, logging pipelines, and SOAR automations. This is a growing organization that combines deep technical expertise with pragmatic risk management to keep pace with the speed and scale of the firm's business.

**What You'll Do**  

* Design, implement, and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, segmentation, secure remote access, intrusion detection and prevention, network detection and response, and network access control, and support secure network architecture for new offices, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
* Build and maintain the logging pipelines and security data lake that power detection across the environment.
* Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, and standards across network security, email security, DNS security, and the security data lake.
* Strengthen perimeter security through automation, improved monitoring, vulnerability identification, and actionable alerting and reporting.
* Monitor, manage, and analyze security logs, alerts, and events across multiple systems to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activity, and tune network infrastructure to reduce risk while minimizing business disruption.
* Apply AI to the team's own work, accelerating investigation, automation, detection engineering, and reporting, and help secure the firm's use of AI models, tools, and frameworks.
* Provide security engineering and consulting support to Security Operations and the wider Information Security organization, and partner with stakeholders across Technology, Trading, Legal, Internal Audit, and Compliance to support and enforce security policies and controls.
* Conduct system audits and vulnerability assessments, manage remediation efforts and findings from audits, penetration tests, and process reviews, participate in incident response for network-related events, and use threat intelligence to sharpen detection, defense, and response.

**What You Bring**  

* 5+ years of hands-on network security experience, ideally within financial services, hedge funds or other buy-side firms, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands-on experience administering enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, VPN, proxies, intrusion detection and prevention, network detection and response, and network access control, with a practical understanding of proxy engineering concepts.
* Proven experience as a security engineer with hands-on expertise in logging pipelines, data lakes, or SIEM platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Sentinel, or S3/Athena, plus SOAR automation; experience with breach and attack simulation tooling is a plus.
* Hands-on AI experience, both using AI tooling in day-to-day security work and securing the use, deployment, and governance of AI models, tools, and frameworks.
* Strong command of core networking and infrastructure concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, segmentation, DNS, Wi-Fi, and virtualization, along with email and DNS security controls and packet capture and network analysis tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or ngrep.
* Experience securing hybrid on-premises and cloud network architectures, with working knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure and proficiency across Windows, Linux, macOS, and container environments such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Scripting or development skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network and security issues under time pressure, operate independently in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and communicate clearly with both deeply technical teams and senior executive stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity/Information Security, or a related field, or commensurate work experience; certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, CISM, CCNP Security, Palo Alto PCNSE, or Fortinet NSE are valued.

title: Smart Factory IoT Security Engineer
description:
**Your role**

  

As Smart Factory Security Engineer, you own the security of every solution onboarded into VTBA's Smart Factory and Industry 4.0 landscape. You act as the security gatekeeper and technical authority for new OT/IIoT systems, connected production equipment, and digital manufacturing solutions from the moment they are evaluated until they are fully integrated and running in production. You embed security by design into every onboarding: assessing risk, defining and enforcing hardening and segmentation requirements, validating secure architectures, and ensuring new systems comply with IEC 62443, NIS2, and internal security policy before and after go-live. You maintain an up-to-date OT/IIoT security posture and asset inventory (CMDB), act as the first point of contact for the business on security matters, and ensure that production processes are never compromised by unsecured or unmanaged systems.You support M&A and integration due diligence from a security standpoint, securing previously unregistered or newly acquired systems, and you collaborate closely with IT, network, production, and external integration partners to guarantee a seamless and secure Industry 4.0 rollout. In case of a security incident or outage tied to onboarded solutions, you drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures.

* Develop the Smart Factory cybersecurity strategy aligned with business and security objectives.
* Design secure architectures for manufacturing systems, Industrial IoT (IIoT), MES, and OT networks
* Own the security review and validation of all new OT/IIoT solutions being onboarded onto Smart Factory / production networks, from design through go-live.
* Define and enforce security-by-design requirements (segmentation, hardening, access control, secure remote access) for new production lines, machines, and digital solutions.
* Be the first point of contact and internal security consultant for production engineers, IT teams, and solution vendors during onboarding projects.
* Maintain a secure and stable OT/IIoT environment for VTBA, including an accurate, continuously updated OT security asset inventory (CMDB).
* Support Smart Factory projects involving IoT, AI, cloud connectivity, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing platforms.
* Define and maintain OT asset inventories, security baselines, and lifecycle management processes.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing of industrial systems.
* Act as the security contact for external production and integration partners, reviewing and validating the security quality of their work before systems connect to company networks.
* Drive compliance with IEC 62443, NIS2, ANSSI-aligned practices, and internal IT/OT security regulations across all onboarded solutions.
* Support M&A and acquisition due diligence, assessing and securing newly acquired or previously unregistered OT/IIoT systems.
* Perform regular on-call duty for security-related escalations on onboarded solutions

  

**To succeed you will need:**

  

* 2+ years' experience securing OT/IIoT or Industry 4.0 environments
* Solid knowledge of IEC 62443 and familiarity with NIS2 and other relevant OT/ICS cybersecurity frameworks.
* Strong understanding of network segmentation, secure remote access, and hardening practices for industrial and IIoT systems.
* Customer Service Skills (interaction with end users and solution vendors).
* ITIL process knowledge.
* Understanding of reporting & data visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI and Excel.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience in OT/IIoT environments, including security log analysis (firewall, OT Defender, machine logs).
* Analytical Skills-able to conduct security risk assessments and analyze log files to identify vulnerabilities and operational limitations.
* Reporting Skills-able to summarize and present periodic security reports and recommend improvements to onboarding procedures.
* Planning Skills-able to define security requirements and roadmaps for new solutions and production facilities.
* Excellent communication skills in English-written and verbal.
* Self-organized and persistent in a polite way to obtain missing information from colleagues, business, and vendors.
* Willing to undertake national and international business travel to support the secure rollout of new OT/IIoT solutions.

  

**In return, we offer you**

  

We offer you a modern and flexible work in a company that manufactures state-of-the-art and innovative vacuum products and systems. You will be part of a young and international team and will have the opportunity to support the latest technologies. This guarantees training and enables you to develop further. We work in flat structures and all IT colleagues are in direct contact with the internal customers to understand their technical needs and support them in technology. Thus, in addition to the technical network knowledge, you will also gain a deep insight into the internal processes and projects of our company.

**Company Description**

The role combines strong customer service, technical troubleshooting, accurate documentation, and effective communication to minimize disruption, maintain business continuity, and deliver a consistent end-user experience.

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and manage incidents and service requests based on impact and urgency.

* Identify recurring issues and share relevant trends to support problem management and continuous improvement.

* Meet agreed service-level, response-time, resolution-time, and escalation targets.

title: Senior Incident Response Analyst
description:
:

**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

**What you'll do:** **Senior Incident Response Analyst** in the **Enterprise** will…

* Lead end-to-end investigations for complex incidents: validate alert context, determine scope, assess impact, and build an audit-ready timeline and evidence trail.
* Apply a forensic mindset to every investigation: preserve volatile and non-volatile evidence early, maintain chain of custody, and ensure findings are reproducible and can withstand legal, regulatory, or client scrutiny.
* Act as an escalation point for high-priority security events and ambiguous cases; guide triage-to-investigation handoffs and ensure defensible conclusions.
* Perform endpoint, memory, and cloud forensic triage (e.g., disk and memory captures, system artifacts, cloud audit logs) to reconstruct attacker activity and root cause; support third-party forensic partners on high-severity cases and validate their findings.
* Coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery actions with system owners and partner teams; verify remediation completion and document closure rationale.
* Partner with the Senior Incident Response Lead on incident command execution, including stakeholder communications cadence, task tracking, and post-incident action closure.
* Leverage the Incident Response Specialist for deep technical analysis and quality reviews; incorporate feedback into investigation standards and templates.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, checklists, and communication templates based on lessons learned and recurring incident patterns.
* Contribute to readiness exercises (tabletops/purple-team activities) and ensure outcomes translate into concrete corrective actions.
* Create incident metrics and reporting inputs (e.g., response timeliness, containment effectiveness, recurring root causes) to support operational governance.
* Use automation as a mindset: identify repeatable steps in investigations suitable for automation or AI assistance (summaries, enrichment notes, evidence packaging) and validate outputs against source artifacts before operational use.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5 years of experience in security operations with hands-on incident response experience, including ownership of complex investigations.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, threat vectors, and incident management practices; ability to distinguish between benign/commodity activity and advanced threats.
* Ability to analyze data from multiple sources (endpoint, cloud, network, and application logs) and produce defensible conclusions.
* Working knowledge of digital forensics fundamentals, including evidence acquisition, chain of custody, Windows/Linux artifacts (e.g., event logs, registry, prefetch, browser history), and timeline analysis.
* Investigative curiosity and strong attention to detail; ability to form and test hypotheses, separate facts from assumptions, and support every conclusion with evidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills, including clear written updates and the ability to present findings in business-friendly language.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and coordinate across multiple teams to drive action closure.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel and cloud security investigations across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
